lines.en: I pulse my bell and drift up.
I swell and shrink in the water.
My tentacles trail beneath me.

lines.zh: 伞盖一收一放，我往深处去。
lines.en: My bell contracts and releases; I drift deeper.
Water weeds slide past my tentacles.
Light leaks down from the surface.
I sink a little deeper.
Then I rise again, slowly.
I glide close to the bottom.
My body is translucent.
I turn and keep drifting.
The water pushes, and I go with it.

lines.zh: 蓝水母漂着，碰一下就疼。
lines.en: Blue jellyfish drifts. Contact stings.
I trail my tentacles downward.
I drift where the light is dim.
I keep still and let the water take me.
I hang nearly motionless.
My bell opens and closes slowly.
The water is still, save its own sound.
My tentacles sway in the water.
Light spreads through my body.
I'm like a lamp in the water.
I can't make out what's above.
I turn a slow, small circle.
A fish passes in the distance.
It doesn't come near.
My body is very light in the water.
The water here is cold.
I turn slowly with the current.

lines.zh: 一尾小鱼在我触须间穿过
lines.en: A small fish slips between my tentacles.
You've come into the water.

lines.zh: 我收了一下伞盖，往上浮。
lines.en: I close my bell once and float upward.
Your movement stirs the water.
My tentacles drift toward you.
You don't know how dangerous this is.
I drift slowly, but I do arrive.
You backed off; the water moves.
I don't chase. The current carries me.
Your shadow is on the bottom.
I drift, and one touch stings.
I contract my bell.
One tentacle is severed.
I sway badly in the water.
I've drifted off course.
A little color in the water.
I slowly return to my shape.

lines.zh: 伞盖破了一角，我漏着水。
lines.en: A corner of my bell is torn, leaking water.
My body is quivering.
I'm still drifting.
My tentacles retract, still tingling.
There's no such smell in the water.
I drift over and look.

lines.zh: 水里没有这种味道，我绕开。
lines.en: No such scent belongs in water; I drift around it.
It's sinking; I follow it down.
I touch it and pull back.
This isn't food.
Lowering it here won't help.
I only move with the water.
Keep it.
I've drifted away.
You touched my tentacles.
My body is soft as water.

lines.zh: 你的肩把我推得转了半圈。
lines.en: Your shoulder sends me turning half a circle.
I drift slowly back.
Your hand passes a little way into me.
I contract once, then open.
The current pushes us apart.
I stop above you.
The water's too shallow for me here.
Stop splashing.
There are other blue shapes in the water.
We only drift alongside each other.
My tentacles touch yours.

lines.zh: 水会带我们去同一个方向
lines.en: The water will carry us the same way.
We need nothing else.
This stretch of water is enough.
Don't come too close.
Touching can hurt.
We stay thus, touching nothing.
When the current shifts, we part.
I curl a tentacle around it.
It slides off me.
I can't hold anything.
It sinks to the bottom.
It sinks; I don't follow.
I nudge it once.
This hardly matters to me.
It drifts beside me.

lines.zh: 我用触须勾了一下，又滑了。
lines.en: I hook it with a tentacle; it slips away.
Let it sink.
The movement in the water has changed.
A blue jellyfish drifts. Touching it hurts.
There's warmth, unlike this place.
My tentacles have stretched out.

lines.zh: 水流会把它送到触须下。
lines.en: The current will bring it beneath my tentacles.
The water will bring it to me.
I wait above it.

lines.zh: 它还在动，很好，我的触手是带电的。
lines.en: It still moves, good; my tentacles carry a charge.
My tentacles have stretched out.
I wait for it to run into me.
I sink slowly.
My tentacles hang around it.

lines.zh: 我在它头顶展开半透明的伞。
lines.en: I spread my translucent bell above it.
The current pushes it this way.
My bell blocks the light.
It's looking up.
One step more and it touches.
It's almost touching now.
The sting travels fast in water.
My blue bell swells and I drift over.
My tentacle brushes across it.
A shock leaves my tentacles.

lines.zh: 触须扫过，水里的电流炸开。
lines.en: My tentacles sweep; current bursts through the water.
A numbness spreads in the water.
I lower my tentacles again.
It retreats; the water shakes.
I don't chase. I drift.
That was only contact.
It has left my reach.
I sink down.
I open slowly in the water.

lines.zh: 我的伞盖第一次鼓起来
lines.en: My bell swells for the first time.
My tentacles hang down one by one.
The water is cold. I'm suited to it.
I drift from where I began.
Light diffuses through me.
There are sounds above the water.
I hang in the middle of the water.
I'm in no hurry to go anywhere.
The water will carry me.
The water heats, and it troubles me.

lines.zh: 我从水里被甩出去，重重落地
lines.en: I'm flung out of the water and hit the ground.
There's not enough air here.

lines.zh: 冲击把水和我一起推开
lines.en: The blast shoves water and me aside.

lines.zh: 一根尖物穿过我的伞盖
lines.en: Something sharp passes through my bell.

lines.zh: 这股力量让我的触须发麻
lines.en: This force numbs my tentacles.

lines.zh: 没东西可吃，我越来越薄
lines.en: Nothing to eat; I grow thinner.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，我浑身一抽
lines.en: Lightning hits the water; I spasm.
The water is gone; I come apart in threads.
